items.title: Search Evolving: Integrate SEO, AEO, and GEO for Visibility
items.summary: Search discovery now spans traditional engines, AI assistants, and direct answers, requiring a unified SEO, AEO, and GEO strategy. Brands adapting to these changes maintain visibility amid evolving behaviors. Emphasizes modern search strategy integration.

items.title: The Old SEO Game Is Over: Enter GEO as the New Standard
items.summary: AI Overviews and tools like ChatGPT are decoupling impressions from clicks, ending traditional SEO dominance. GEO optimizes for AI citations via structured content, E-E-A-T, and proprietary data. Shift to Search Everywhere Optimization across platforms like Reddit and TikTok.

items.title: geo-seo-claude: Open-Source Toolkit for AI/GEO Optimization
items.summary: New Claude-built tool geo-seo-claude audits URLs to explain why AIs like ChatGPT skip citing content and provides fixes. Highlights booming GEO market and higher conversion from AI traffic. Free MIT-licensed alternative to expensive agencies.

items.title: Nearly 10,000 Authors Publish Empty Book to Protest AI Stealing Work
items.summary: Nearly 10,000 authors published a mostly empty book titled 'Don't Steal This Book' to protest AI companies using their works without permission for training data. The action urges the UK government not to alter copyright laws in favor of AI firms. Copies are being distributed for free at the London Book Fair.

items.title: Official BookTok Chart Set to Launch in the UK
items.summary: NielsenIQ BookData and Media Control are partnering to release the first official BookTok charts in the United Kingdom. This development acknowledges TikTok's substantial impact on book sales and reading trends. The charts will highlight socially driven popular titles.

items.title: Publishers Must Act on AI Misinformation Now
items.summary: Publishers in trade and academic sectors are called to proactively shield readers from AI-produced misinformation. Emphasis is placed on immediate measures before widespread manipulation takes hold. This addresses challenges in writing, editing, and content integrity.

items.title: Publishing Captured by Woke Ideology
items.summary: The publishing industry has been overtaken by woke ideology for years, resulting in censorship of certain content. Recommendation to turn to older books and independent authors to avoid this. Classics like Hemingway, Lewis, Tolkien likely unpublishable by Big 5 today.

items.title: AI Flooding Amazon with Books, BookTokers Involved
items.summary: AI-generated books are inundating Amazon, with even prominent BookTok influencers participating. Amazon is responding by banning accounts caught using AI in book creation. Debate on whether short-term gains justify the ban risks.

items.title: UK Counter-Terror Flags Orwell, Tolkien, Lewis as Far-Right
items.summary: Britain's counter-terrorism program has included works by George Orwell, C.S. Lewis, and J.R.R. Tolkien in 'far-right' analysis. This raises issues around scrutiny of traditional literature. Coverage by The Free Press highlights the concern.

items.title: Oscars 2026 Ratings Flop Blamed on Woke Celebrity Rants
items.summary: The 2026 Academy Awards suffered a major ratings disaster, with viewers and commentators attributing the decline to excessive woke sermons and political statements by celebrities. Hosts described the event as a 'clown show' filled with virtue signaling that alienated audiences. Mel Gibson criticized the woke elites following the ceremony.

items.title: Timothée Chalamet Faces Backlash Over Ballet and Opera Comments
items.summary: Actor Timothée Chalamet sparked controversy with remarks dismissing ballet and opera, leading to growing backlash from fans and stars in the performing arts community. The incident fueled debates on celebrity respect for other art forms amid Oscar voting. Other celebrities have fired back in defense.

items.title: Gavin Newsom's Wife Pushed Preachy Gender Films into California Schools
items.summary: Jennifer Siebel Newsom utilized state resources to promote films addressing 'toxic masculinity' in classrooms, drawing criticism for being overly preachy. The initiative leaned on her husband's influence and the education board. Reports highlight the contentious content pushed into schools.

items.title: Audiences Reject Woke Sermons at Awards Shows
items.summary: Viewers express frustration with awards shows like the Oscars, citing condescending woke sermons and virtue signaling as reasons for tuning out. Once enjoyed for fashion and glamour, the events now feel preachy and hypocritical. Many have stopped watching since Hollywood's shift.

items.title: Fans Backlash Over Show Producers' Silence on Racism Against Lead Actor
items.summary: Producers of a show marketed as a safe space remained silent for months amid daily racism directed at their lead actor, only responding under pressure. Fans feel unwelcome and unsafe as a result. The incident has led to widespread disappointment.

items.title: Rachel Zegler Faces Backlash for Mocking Snow White and Fans
items.summary: Rachel Zegler continues to draw criticism for mocking the original Snow White film, picking fights with fans, and talking down to audiences. She expressed confusion over the backlash but refuses to assimilate or take responsibility. Her comments reinforce why studios hesitate to hire her.

items.title: Fewer than 1 in 5 Small Businesses Effectively Integrate AI
items.summary: A Goldman Sachs survey indicates that only 14% of small business owners have fully embedded AI across their core operations, despite many experimenting with AI apps. Most remain at surface level without deep integration. This underscores challenges in achieving meaningful AI impact for SMBs.

items.title: Small Businesses Report Positive AI Impacts but Need Training
items.summary: Over 76% of small businesses are using AI, with 93% noting positive effects like increased efficiency and productivity. However, they require more training and support to maximize benefits. The survey highlights AI's growing role in SMB operations.

items.title: Google Expands Free AI Marketing Suite to 170+ Countries for SMBs
items.summary: Google's Pomelli tool now lets small businesses input a website URL to auto-generate brand-matched ads, social posts, headlines, CTAs, and animated videos. Expanded globally, it uses advanced AI models for precise, non-generic content. This major update democratizes professional marketing for small businesses.

items.title: Andrej Karpathy Launches Open-Source AI Job Replacement Risk Tool
items.summary: Karpathy's project scores all 342 US occupations on AI displacement risk (0-10), averaging 5.3, with digital/remote jobs most vulnerable. Features an interactive treemap sized by job numbers and colored by exposure. Valuable for small business leaders planning AI transitions and workforce strategies.
